subject: Hotfix activation for locked-environment cluster - signing & rollout sequence
messages:
From: Harper Zhou <harper.zhou@equinox-health.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Locked cluster hotfix window and artifact handoff

Hi Priya,

We have a critical hotfix (security patch for model runtime dependency) that needs to be applied to the islanded cluster in our Boise facility during the maintenance window next Tuesday (2026-03-10 02:00-03:30 UTC). The cluster is fully air-gapped — courier will deliver media and an operator will perform manual activation.

Two asks from Redwood before we proceed:
1) A signed artifact manifest (SHA256 checksums + signing key id) we can verify locally before activation.
2) A short activation sequence/checklist that the on-site operator can follow; we need to confirm any preflight KV-cache purge and fallback plan.

We can stage courier delivery on Monday evening. If you prefer, I can loop in our on-site ops lead (Tom Blake) for the handoff.

Thanks — Harper
Harper Zhou
Director, Platform Ops
Equinox Health

(attachment: operator-checklist-request.txt)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Harper Zhou <harper.zhou@equinox-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-07T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Locked cluster hotfix window and artifact handoff

Harper — thanks for the heads up. We can support the delivery and verification. High-level plan below; details and artifacts attached.

Summary plan (short):
- We will produce: signed-manifest.tar.gz (manifest.json + checksums), hotfix-binary-v1.2.3.tar (payload), and a detached signature hotfix-signature-v1.2.3.sig.
- On your side: verify signatures using our public key (RSA PSS key id: rwd-key-2024-prod) and confirm checksums.
- Operator checklist: follow step 1-8 in operator-checklist-v2.pdf. Notably: snapshot existing images, export KV cache to removable media (if possible), verify network isolation, then apply binary and run smoke tests.
- Fallback: if smoke tests fail, operator should re-image from snapshot and attach the failure log (see checklist).

I attached the signed-manifest and the operator checklist for your review. Ben will handle the signature delivery and I’ll coordinate the DocuSign for the on-site acceptance form if needed.

Questions for you:
- Confirm courier ETA and whether Tom Blake will be present.
- Any change to your maintenance window?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior PM, Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

(attachments: signed-manifest.tar.gz, operator-checklist-v2.pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Locked cluster hotfix window and artifact handoff

Quick tech notes for the on-site operator (please include in checklist):
- Preflight: confirm model-serving processes are quiesced and that the KV cache has been flushed via the local admin console; we rely on a file-based cache snapshot (see step 2).
- The hotfix binary replaces the inference kernel library (libattn.so). The smoke test is a 2-token local generation against a pinned model — allow 60s for kernel JIT warmup.
- If signature verification fails: do NOT attempt to apply. Capture the signature check output and the manifest file and place them in the courier return envelope.
- Logging: enable debug-forwarding to the sealed-device log collector on the removable media; this will help us debug without network egress.

I created a short Jira with runbook pointers: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/OPS-4821 — please reference it in the handoff note.

-Karthik
Engineering Lead, Inference Runtime

Subject: Re: Locked cluster hotfix window and artifact handoff

Harper — signing artifact uploaded and courier slot confirmed. Deliverables attached to this message: hotfix-binary-v1.2.3.tar (payload) and hotfix-signature-v1.2.3.sig (detached signature).

Operational notes:
- Courier ETA Monday 2026-03-09 22:00 PST to the Boise data center guard. Tom Blake confirmed attendance and will sign chain-of-custody.
- On-site acceptance: operator to verify signature with our public key (rwd-key-2024-prod.pub). If verification passes, proceed with steps 3-7 in operator-checklist-v2.pdf.
- Post-activation: operator will copy the sealed-device logs to the return media. We will evaluate results and, if needed, issue a rollback image.

Attachments included: hotfix-binary-v1.2.3.tar, hotfix-signature-v1.2.3.sig

Ben Carter
Systems Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0229
